# VaultAPI

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description | Behavior | Returns | Auth Roles |
| -------- | ----------- | -------- | ------- | ---------- |
| `GET /vault/me` | Return the vault owner profile |  | `VaultUser` | owner |
| `POST /vault/lock` | Seal the vault and wipe session keys | `VaultUser.lock` |  |  |
| `POST /vault/unlock` | Unseal the vault by verifying the passphrase | `VaultUser.unlock` |  |  |
| `POST /vault/recover/start` | Begin recovery using the BIP-39 phrase | `VaultUser.startRecovery` |  |  |
| `POST /vault/recover/complete` | Complete recovery with a new passphrase | `VaultUser.completeRecovery` |  |  |
| `GET /vault/claims` | List all claims in the vault |  | `Claim` | owner |
| `POST /vault/claims` | Add a new claim to the vault |  | `Claim` | owner |
| `GET /vault/claims/:id` | Read one claim |  | `Claim` | owner |
| `DELETE /vault/claims/:id` | Permanently delete a claim |  |  | owner |
| `GET /vault/grants` | List all grants |  | `Grant` | owner |
| `POST /vault/grants` | Create a new grant (push or pull) |  | `Grant` | owner |
| `GET /vault/grants/:id` | Read one grant |  | `Grant` | owner |
| `POST /vault/grants/:id/revoke` | Revoke a grant immediately | `Grant.revoke` |  |  |
| `GET /vault/audit` | List audit log entries, newest first |  | `AuditEntry` | owner |
